jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one 16:9 landscape illustration (1536x864 or 1672x941 composition) for a DIRECT SEQUEL to these exact supplied picture-book images. This is an identity-preserving continuation, not a fresh interpretation. Match the reference's fine colored pencil marks, layered warm watercolor, detailed leaf texture, golden yellow-green dappled light, soft ink edges, enormous forest trees. EXACT same squirrel: small glossy black oval eyes, round cream muzzle and belly, tiny brown nose, rosy cheeks, forehead stripes, orange-brown squat body, huge rounded curled striped tail, red neckerchief only. Do not redesign, oversimplify, make 3D, change proportions, darken forest, add clothing. Exact white rabbit with blue patterned neckerchief and round brown bear with green neckerchief when called for. No words, letters, watermarks, logos or speech bubbles. Keep key figures clear of bottom 12% (native slide caption will go there). Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute character/style/composition anchor. Preserve the entire original forest, sunlight, ground, flowers, and original squirrel holding the acorn in the same pose and position. Remove ALL existing Japanese title lettering and the wooden-letter objects from the upper half, seamlessly filling with the existing golden hazy forest. Add only a delicate small strand of muted red, cream and sage triangular festival pennants along the upper outside tree branches. Central upper half remains bright quiet space for the new title to be typeset later. Do not put pennants across central title space. This must look like the very same cover illustration minimally edited for the sequel.
